# Lifecycle Engine

## Rules
- Domain exports `evaluateLifecycleVerdict`, `projectArtifacts`, `findBlockingParent`, `resolveLifecycleNextHop`; no `LifecycleEngine` class. Application `evaluateLifecycle` adds command guidance.
- Project supplied predicate `CheckResult` only; domain runs no I/O/effects/snapshots/fallback check execution. Status collects candidates; transition fail-fast protocol.
- Effective artifacts: preserve review states; complete with review-blocked parent → `pending-parent-artifact-review`; other incomplete parent → `in-progress`; review wins. Canonical states only.
- Blockers include code/message/skippability/bypass/affected files; active bypass removes blocker. Core codes cover incomplete, drift/review, tasks, overlap, invalid transition, approval.
- Pipeline, legal transitions, available targets, optional skips derive workflow topology plus complete candidate results; no hardcoded sequence. `impl.linksInScope` alone skippable.
- `nextHop` selects furthest bypassable optional path; no command. Application maps selected target to skills/approvals/archive and never recomputes.
- Archiving exposes recovery `archivable` and redesign; recovery skips normal requires/tasks. Next artifact scans `artifactDag().topologicalOrder()`.

## Constraints
- Persisted aggregate/history remains on `Change`; DAG state derived.
- Effects never execute in verdict.
- Live archive overlap differs from victim overlap review.
